items.text: Cardinals ruled out RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) for Sunday’s game vs the Rams. Will rest ankle for long-term healing; no IR planned.
items.why: Ailing ankle; sat practices; coach wants long-term rest.
items.implication: Cardinals RB committee shifts; backup volume spike vs Rams.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps for other ARI RBs (e.g. any committee mates).

items.text: Ravens ruled out Lamar Jackson for Sunday’s game at Cleveland due to his ankle injury. Tyler Huntley expected to start again.
items.why: Missed all practices this week with ankle sprain from Week 4; not spotted Friday.
items.implication: Huntley starts; Flowers and Ravens pass-catchers see lower ceiling, Ravens offense less explosive.
items.opportunity: Tyler Huntley full snaps; Zay Flowers volume may hold but efficiency drops.

items.text: Jets ruled out RB Breece Hall (quad) for Sunday’s game vs the Patriots, along with WR Adonai Mitchell (finger).
items.implication: Jets RB snaps fully to backups; Breece multi-week absence continues.
items.opportunity: Full opportunity for Jets RBs behind Hall (e.g. any handcuff).

items.text: Jalen Hurts out for Week 6 (and indefinitely) with superficial blood clot in calf; Tanner McKee to start. Eagles adding Joe Milton for depth.
items.why: Superficial blood clot discovered; out indefinitely.
items.implication: McKee starts; Eagles offense less dual-threat, lower floor for skill players if Saquon/Smith limited too.
items.opportunity: Tanner McKee full snaps; potential boost to WRs/TEs in pass game, but overall scoring down.

items.text: Texans RB David Montgomery (groin), WR Tank Dell (knee) and S Jalen Pitre (shoulder) will not travel to London and are ruled out vs Jaguars.
items.implication: Full snaps to HOU RB backups (e.g. Marks/Pierce types); Dell absence boosts other WRs.
items.opportunity: Lead back role for remaining Texans RBs; more targets to Nico Collins et al.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson diagnosed with high-ankle sprain but practiced this week and feels pretty good; status TBD for Week 6.
items.why: Surprised he could practice; high-ankle but progressing.
items.implication: Possible return or limited; Rhamondre Stevenson still elevated if out.
items.opportunity: If OUT, full volume to Rhamondre Stevenson; if IN, split or lead.

items.text: Falcons QB Michael Penix Jr. has no injury designation for Sunday’s game and is expected to start vs. the Bears (ribs).
items.implication: Penix starts; stabilizes Falcons offense for London/Bijan.
items.opportunity: Full QB snaps for Penix; normal usage for Drake London, Bijan Robinson.

items.text: Levitan notes Eagles gold standard moving on from aging stars early (Dawkins, McNabb, etc.); Saquon turns 30 in Feb—if contender needs RB, call now. Agrees risk of too early better than too late.
items.why: Age 30 soon; Eagles precedent for early exits; current hamstring DNPs.
items.implication: Potential trade candidate; monitor workload/ROS value carefully amid injury.
items.opportunity: If traded or limited, backups rise; current DNP risks sitting.

items.text: Matthew Berry loves Mike Evans as his WR4 this week vs Commanders secondary; all-in on the matchup and volume.
items.why: Soft Commanders secondary; Evans volume and role bankable.
items.implication: Strong start; top-5 WR play potential.
items.opportunity: High targets/routes vs weak pass D.

items.text: With Hurts out, Berry likes Tanner McKee as the fill-in starter for Eagles.
items.why: Hurts blood clot out; McKee gets the start.
items.implication: Streamable QB option; supports Eagles skill if volume holds.
items.opportunity: Full pass snaps to McKee; potential checkdowns to Barkley/Goedert if healthy.

items.text: Berry loves Drake London vs CHI as WR6; banks on usage and matchup.
Berry loves Kyren Williams vs ARI as RB5; elite recent usage vs leaky run D.
items.why: Elite usage; ARI run defense weak.

items.text: Berry hates Jaylen Waddle vs SEA as WR28; fades amid timid Bo Nix play and matchup.
items.why: Nix historically timid; tough SEA secondary; shoulder scare in TNF.

items.text: Pat Thorman’s Week 6 Rankings live on ETR; also Man vs Machine, OL/DL mismatches (Rams DL 8th > Cards OL 30th), MHJ trade fallout (Bourne more targets than MHJ did).
items.why: Usage/ROS focus; mismatches and trade notes.
items.implication: Update lineups with Thorman ranks; Bourne upgrade in HOU, MHJ debut monitor.
items.opportunity: Kendrick Bourne target share up post-MHJ trade; OL/DL edges for Rams run D.
